referenceDevice: BPI-R4 (MediaTek MT7988A/Filogic 880), combined EthWAN + EasyMesh Controller/Agent build
measurementCondition: 10-second aggregate /proc/stat sample (idle-delta method); all 4 cores online at 1800 MHz, governor=performance; traffic condition and connected-client count not recorded. Not a controlled loaded-workload test.
notes: Only aggregate CPU utilization has been measured (5.56% averaged over 10 seconds, load average 0.18/0.65/0.42); no per-process CPU time or percentage breakdown has been captured. This sample reflects idle/light-load conditions only — a loaded sample (EasyMesh formed, active Wi-Fi clients, sustained WAN throughput) has not yet been collected, and the profile's assumed hardware NAT/flow offload capability (see Section 3, CA-007) has not been confirmed or refuted by this measurement either way. Per-process CPU profiling and loaded-condition testing remain open items.
